title: Primary KPI lacks a clear business definition
rationale: A technically correct measure is not useful if stakeholders do not share its definition.
evidence_required: KPI definitions, measure names, stakeholder context
review_note: Exploratory metrics may be intentionally informal.

title: Dashboard emphasizes activity metrics over decision-oriented outcomes
rationale: Reports should prioritize metrics that support decisions and business outcomes.
review_note: Operational dashboards may legitimately focus on activity.

title: KPI lacks target, benchmark, trend or comparison context
rationale: A number without context is often difficult to interpret or act on.
review_note: Some absolute metrics are self-explanatory or compliance-driven.

title: Report content is not aligned to the intended audience
rationale: Executive, analyst and operational users need different levels of detail and interaction.
review_note: A multipurpose report can serve several audiences if navigation is deliberate.

title: No obvious action path from exception to detail/root cause
rationale: Decision-support reports should enable users to investigate important deviations efficiently.
review_note: Static executive summaries may intentionally stop at high level.

title: Critical metric logic is disconnected from business process/source-of-truth
rationale: KPI logic should be traceable to an agreed process or authoritative source.
review_note: Cannot be concluded from PBIX alone; requires customer confirmation.
